rationale: The bid/ask (14.65/14.70) indicates the real executable market is already through the original take-profit of $14.90, meaning the short thesis has mechanically completed its measured objective; closing here locks in the full target gain rather than risking a mean-reversion bounce from an already deeply extended intraday move. Price is sitting at just 3.3% of today's range with the day's low at $15.08 nearly breached, and gap-and-dump exhaustion bounces from deeply oversold intraday lows are common, making further holding a poor risk/reward. No new catalysts have emerged to extend the thesis, and with a wide quoted spread and extreme relative volume (50x), slippage risk on a delayed exit grows with each passing minute.
